cards.mood: The piece opens with a serene, contemplative atmosphere that suggests safety and reflection.
cards.vocal: The track features a Lead Male Vocalist with a warm, resonant baritone texture that conveys sincerity and stability.
cards.palette: An acoustic piano serves as the harmonic backbone throughout the entire track, playing arpeggiated figures in the verses and transitioning to fuller, block chords in the choruses to drive the emotional momentum.
